scope: Ordinary main-loop scouting, discovery, priced selection, mining/courier/reserver/distributor recruitment, independent receipt classification and loaded withdrawal for one configured outpost. Canonical static topology identity across visibility transitions. Not full infrastructure payback or whole ED-29/RC qualification.

diagnostic.finding: Initial unconstrained multi-room trial did not cover birth expenditure and churned cancelled births. The final scenario both restricts admitted neighbors and normalizes visibility identity; do not attribute the entire cost difference to one change. Unit regression independently proves canonical live/retained identity for equal static cells.

limitations: A prebuilt remote container and developed RCL6 home are supplied infrastructure. Confirmed deliveries cover observed workforce births, not initial home/container construction, idle/warmup opportunity cost or complete expansion payback.
Only E0N1 is admitted; three other home-adjacent rooms are explicitly blocked. Multi-room portfolio startup churn and broader scalable pressure remain unqualified.

The scout receives an operator target but no remote witness, seeded lease, direct management call or workforce profile is supplied. Initial capital is2300 spawn/extension energy plus8000 storage; no mid-run resources or lifetimes are injected.

Receipt classification includes remote-transport authority and cargo recovered from known remote actors; local home redistribution uses a separate receipt identity set and cannot inflate remote income.

Final capital reconciliation includes all surviving actor cargo and accepted birth costs aligned with the next engine observation. Source stock capacity/regeneration is never credited directly as home income.
Lost-vision/threat recovery, longer-route contention, source full-life reachability, adaptive capacity, alternate-home ownership and ED-43 aggregate pressure/soak remain open.
CPU/memory samples include the1000-row probe overhead and do not qualify production performance.
